steps.tx: One small vessel has cheated fate in this otherwise devastated retina. While the surrounding fundus lies pale and swollen from a blocked central artery, a wedge of macula keeps its colour and the patient keeps reading vision. That rescued island survives thanks to a **cilioretinal artery**, a choroidal branch present in a minority of eyes that bypasses the retinal circulation entirely. Spotting it explains the puzzling mismatch between a catastrophic looking fundus and a surprisingly preserved acuity chart result.
steps.say: A cilioretinal artery can spare the macula and preserve reading vision despite central retinal artery occlusion.
